messages:
elaine.p (Partnerships): Heads up — ClearPath (SI partner) asked for a simple lead routing matrix for co-sell pipeline. Want to avoid ping-pong between SEs/AEs and make sure marketplace leads get routed correctly. Can we agree on a short play today?
ryan_s (Sales): +1. Main ask: who owns the first touch and when do we hand to AE vs letting SI nurture. Also need CRM tagging so we can report on influenced ARR.
anjali_se (SolutionsEng): From SE side: we can do intro + technical qualification for first 2 calls (prod-fit, infra constraints). If they request a pilot or PoC, hand to AE to price and own commercial terms. Suggest qualification checklist.
chris_ae (AccountExec): Agree on the flow. Quick suggestion:

1) SI inbound lead from marketplace or partner -> Partnerships triage (elaine)
2) If < $50k ARR expected -> SI leads discovery and SE supports
3) If >= $50k or requests contract/discounts -> route to AE

We should be flexible but need a dollar threshold and clear tags.
si_partner_rep (SI:ClearPath): From our side, we need a predictable SLA. Typical plays are managed services + integration (avg deal $120k). We usually expect joint AE involvement on first commercial ask. Happy to adopt tagging.
marta_legal (Legal): Quick flag — if SI wants to negotiate data residency or special indemnities, route to Legal early. Also, include a “special terms” checkbox in the intake form.
elaine.p (Partnerships): Good call. I'll propose minimal CRM tags for us to standardize:

```
source: si_clearpath
lead_type: co-sell
engagement_stage: si_intro | se_qual | ae_qualified | contract
expected_arr_range: <50k | 50-200k | >200k
roi_use_case: short string
```

Use the pipe options as enum values.
ryan_s (Sales): That works. For reporting, we also need a field for "partner_contact" and "si_owner". Can we add that?
anjali_se (SolutionsEng): Add a quick SE qualification checklist (we can store as a link to a shared doc):
- infra compatibility (GPU/region)
- data residency / compliance needs
- sample workload size (QPS / tokens)
- success criteria for pilot

If any of these are red flags, escalate to AE+Partnerships.
chris_ae (AccountExec): Also recommend a 5-business-day SLA for routing from triage to owner. If not routed, auto-assign to regional AE. That prevents leads falling through.
si_partner_rep (SI:ClearPath): SLA is doable. We also want a co-marketing checkbox for joint announcements — can that be in the intake so we don't lose PR ops later?
elaine.p (Partnerships): Yes — add "co-marketing_interest: yes/no" and "announcement_timing" field. We'll capture basics up front.
marta_legal (Legal): For joint announcements, Partnerships should CC Legal early for brand and claims review. Add a quick template to the intake doc.
deploy-bot: Deploy note — intake form template updated: /docs/si-co-sell-intake-v2 (preview)
ryan_s (Sales): Next steps I propose:
- Elaine to update intake template with tags & fields (today)
- Anjali to add SE checklist link (tomorrow)
- Chris to confirm $ threshold with revenue ops (EOD)
- ClearPath rep to confirm SLA and co-marketing interest (this thread)

If we agree, I'll create a short runbook we can push to the partner portal.
si_partner_rep (SI:ClearPath): Confirmed: SLA ok, co-marketing yes for flagship deals, typical TTR 2-3 weeks for technical scoping. We'll start tagging leads with `source:si_clearpath` immediately.
elaine.p (Partnerships): Sounds good. I'll publish the intake and ping sales-ops for automation rules. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if this aligns?
ryan_s (Sales): :thumbsup:
anjali_se (SolutionsEng): :thumbsup:
chris_ae (AccountExec): :thumbsup:
marta_legal (Legal): :thumbsup:
si_partner_rep (SI:ClearPath): :thumbsup: thanks!
elaine.p (Partnerships): Great — action items:
- elaine.p: update intake + publish (today) — owner
- anjali_se: add SE checklist link (tomorrow)
- chris_ae: confirm threshold with revops (EOD)
- ryan_s: create runbook + partner-portal doc (this week)
- marta_legal: draft announcement template (next Tue)

I'll follow up with a doc link when live.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 3 days (automated)
